{{Quote|I'm sorry senator Braxis&mdash;The Imperial throne cannot interfere with local politics''"<br />"''But you promised&mdash;|Galactic Emperor Palpatine refuses senator Braxis aid for the planet|<ref name="DT1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref>}}
After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''planet''' was represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by the [[Pho Ph'eahian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Braxis]]. One [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the declaration of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Empire's [[Politics/Legends|political]] regime, Braxis requested aid for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Despite the fact that he had previously promised the senator the aid he was asking for, the Emperor told the Pho Ph'eahian that he could not help him, as the Imperial throne was unable to interfere in local politics.<ref name="SW:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet's existence was first implied in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]], which was the first issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' series and the [[Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere|''The Path to Nowhere'']] story arc. It was later directly mentioned in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in an entry for Braxis.
